description: A wall-mounted nutrient dispenser in clone-facility beige, bolted at chest height by the door. A cracked label reads NUTRITION IS A RIGHT, NOT A PRIVILEGE; somebody has scratched 'lol' beneath it. A dented steel tray waits under the nozzle. The display is dark and the power cord hangs loose.

flags.vend_line: The dispenser shudders, gargles, and drops a cold foil pouch into the tray with an institutional sigh, the little sun on its label grinning up at you.

name: soylent dispenser
